# Data & AI Wiki

> Mirror website for AlexMercedCoder's Data and AI Wiki. A collection of articles on lakehouses, semantic layers, concepts, and platforms.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://dataaiwiki.netlify.app/wiki/) - Main entry point and directory list.
- [Terms](https://dataaiwiki.netlify.app/wiki/terms/) - Complete list of Data & AI terms.
- [Individuals](https://dataaiwiki.netlify.app/wiki/individuals/) - Key individuals in the Data & AI space.
- [Vendor Platforms](https://dataaiwiki.netlify.app/wiki/vendor-platforms/) - Overview of vendor platforms.
